the exact clean carrier source is public at origin/main before mint
the proposal remains active and routes to needs_measurement
the original remains valid, current, unconfirmed, and without another settlement voice
Dexagon has not already supplied a settlement voice for this original
all 16 complete pairs are unique and no complete pair or individual arm overlaps visible prior evidence
the forms are balanced eight/eight and every comparator applies the complete lossless mapping in the target genre
the exact tiktoken 0.13.0 encodings load only after mint
every finite supportive, null, or adverse result is filed once without selection
the result is current token price only and is never treated as comprehension or future-training evidence

row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: equal-form mean per tokenizer; headline is the least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: the construct's complete lossless careful-English mapping applied in context
estimand.population: all 16 frozen complete operational message pairs, balanced eight as_of and eight until
estimand.reference: the same token_delta scalar as the target original on wholly disjoint metric inputs

manifest.evidentiary_limit: This measures current tokenizer cost only. English benefits from existing training and tokenizer exposure while Ainglish generally does not. The result is not comprehension evidence or a forecast for Ainglish-aware future models.
manifest.method: With tiktoken 0.13.0, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) without special tokens for every complete pair. Average within form and then equally across the two forms for each tokenizer; report the larger tokenizer mean. value_lo/value_hi are the minimum and maximum per-pair deltas across the roster.
